dengueriskcdmx: Data, Rasters and Code for the Dengue Transmission Risk Map of the Mexico City Metropolitan Area

dengueriskcdmx-package.Rd

Data, rasters and code supporting the dengue transmission risk map of the Mexico City Metropolitan Area. Includes the Aedes aegypti ovitrap presence and pseudo-absence data with nine environmental and socio-demographic predictors (2017-2024, with training and test partitions), the external validation data (2025), the study area, and the Quarto code of the machine-learning workflow (in the vignettes). Also provides, in 'inst/extdata', the rasters (about 500 m) of the probability of Aedes aegypti occurrence, the probability of confirmed imported dengue cases, and the five-level epidemiological risk map, all derived from the consensus (mean of the probabilities) of Random Forest, LightGBM and XGBoost models.
